# Vehicle repair

Used in [Engineering](/rules/80-engineering).

## Notes

- Die modifiers are in the rules (SPI 22.34, restated in rules/80-engineering.md), not on the chart: the chart's own note on die-roll additions is void (Sept 1979 errata, E-017), which is why this file carries no modifier and the die runs 0-8
- Field columns: truck points repaired (2 = two light/medium or one heavy; 1 = one light/medium), armoured car / recce points repaired, and the percent of one tank type repaired; 'na' on the chart (die 7-8, unreachable for a field roll) is null. Facility columns are the percent of the vehicles under repair returned, temporary vs major facility
- A starred 10 % is ignored when only a single point is under repair (single_point_ignores_ten_percent lists the starred columns per row)
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 102) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p8): 0 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
